beats.text: Here is the summit, with the storm all around, gold under a golden light sky, the hour still late afternoon. You notice an absent mayor before anything else.

beats.speaker: Sefa
beats.text: Sefa tells you: "You stand at the ordeal, whether you name it or not."

beats.speaker: Veil
beats.text: Veil says quietly: "You keep refusing leadership. I am only what you buried."
You remember — Courage is fear that has decided to keep walking — and the echo of it changes the shape of this moment.
Someone is depending on you, and an absent mayor is where it happens, now.

beats.speaker: Sefa
beats.text: Sefa, who first met you earlier on the road, is here again where it is hardest. "I said we'd meet once more. You already carry what you need — use it."

beats.speaker: Veil
beats.text: Veil steps out of the dark and, this time, does not move aside. "No more going around me. Whatever you do next, you do it facing me."
Someone nearby does the unexpected, and the moment tilts.

beats.text: You arrive at the high places where the wind lives, after the storm. The air is charged, the dusk soft, the weather golden light. You notice an absent mayor before anything else.

beats.speaker: the Grinning Stranger
beats.text: the Grinning Stranger, a quick-tongued opportunist who finds the joke in any disaster, speaks. "Oh, you want courage. The rules are softer than you think."

beats.speaker: Dren
beats.text: Dren, a steady companion who throws in their lot with yours, speaks. "This is seizing the reward. You won't do this alone."
What you came for lies within reach — an absent mayor glints with the thing itself.

beats.speaker: the Grinning Stranger
beats.text: the Grinning Stranger — the one who fled when you called — comes back, eyes low. "I ran. I know I did. Will you trust me to stand with you this time?"

beats.speaker: Dren
beats.text: Dren, who stood beside you earlier on the road, arrives with exactly what is needed. "You helped me once. Let me return it."
Far off, a single light answers a light you did not know you'd shown.
